learningObjectives: Prepare a supported Windows environment for Commander.
Configure the assigned license type and check its validity.
Enable the target browser extension for local XBrowser scanning.
Validate an authorized practice environment before exercises.

elements.text: These notes describe Tosca On-Premises 2026.1, not a certified reproduction of the Academy course. Commander requires a supported Windows environment. For another host, arrange compatible Windows access and verify architecture, virtualization and organizational support; no named hypervisor or Boot Camp configuration is certified here.

elements.caption: Independent environment guide. A hypervisor name does not certify Windows architecture, Tosca compatibility or licensing.

elements.text: Independent guidance: use an authorized disposable application, test credentials and reversible data. Do not assume a publicly reachable website permits every automation action.

The current requirements specify 64-bit Windows 10/11, an i5 dual-core 2.4 GHz CPU, 8 GB RAM (16 GB recommended), 10 GB storage plus 1.5 GB system-drive installer cache, and 100 Mbit/s network. Recheck the linked matrix for your release and engine.

The software list includes .NET 10 Desktop Runtime and Hosting Bundle, Visual C++ redistributables and WebView2. WebView2 must be installed beforehand; use the current matrix rather than the obsolete .NET 4.7.2-only advice.

Launch the installation executable and follow its checks. Choose the default Commander components or a custom setup; inspect the final summary and logs for failures. Keep Tosca_Projects persistent and do not place it or APPDATA on a network drive. Browser extensions can be selected during setup.

Use the license type provided by your administrator or training entitlement. For online node-locked activation in Tosca 2023.2 or later, open Project → License, then Setup → Activate licenses → Local Machine. Enter your Activation ID and total quantity, activate, then use Setup → Change connection to select the local machine. Internet access through TCP 443 is required. This is not a universal .lic import procedure.

In Manage, select Cloud License, Local Machine or License Server and apply to inspect availability and validity. Refresh recently changed allocations. Returning checked-out licenses may be required to inspect the rest of the pool. Independent guidance: obtain your actual eligibility, expiry and fulfillment terms; no free-license or 30–90-day duration promise is made here.

studyGuide.sectionTitle: Connect an assigned cloud license server

elements.text: An administrator must add your account to the intended cloud license server. In the license configuration, choose Setup → Change connection → Connect to Cloud hosted License Server. Sign in with Support Hub credentials; enable Use default proxy when applicable. A successful connection returns to the start screen.

Independent troubleshooting: a later license prompt is not proof of a corrupted installer or a missing file. Inspect the configured source, entitlement availability, validity and connectivity before contacting the license administrator.

For XBrowser/XScan browser automation, install the Tricentis Automation Extension through Tosca setup, the browser or the documented manual route. XScan can direct you to the store if the extension is missing or outdated. In Chrome, add and confirm the extension, allow access to file URLs as documented, and inspect the Automation possible status.

Independent guidance: configure the actual browser being scanned, not an unrelated browser on another host. For a Windows guest running the local test, prepare that guest browser. This local setup guidance does not rule out separately configured remote automation. Do not diagnose every scanning failure solely from administrator privileges.

studyGuide.sectionTitle: Verify readiness without guessing the cause

elements.text: Independent checklist: confirm Commander launches, the intended license is usable, the target browser has the required extension, and the authorized application is reachable. Record the exact failure and inspect the appropriate component; a license prompt, scan failure and slow guest do not have one universal fix.

Do not treat 4 GB as the documented Commander minimum. Allocate resources against the current matrix and the rest of the workload. A successful environment check is preparation, not proof that an application test passed.

studyGuide.sectionTitle: Check your own Academy completion requirements

elements.text: Academy enrollment, award names, course prerequisites and certificate policies can change. The gated course and credential article were unavailable for verification. Check the requirements and award record for your own enrolled course; this independent module does not promise a badge, certificate, points or a particular training-license offer.

examPitfalls.title: Assuming all host configurations are supported
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Treating any Windows VM as automatically compatible.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Verify the release matrix, architecture and specific environment.

examPitfalls.title: Configuring the wrong browser
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Adding an extension to a host browser while scanning the guest browser.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Prepare the actual local browser being scanned.

examPitfalls.title: Assuming every license is a file
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Applying one historical import path to all entitlements.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Use the documented configuration for the assigned license type.

examPitfalls.title: Guessing entitlement terms
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Assuming a fixed free offer, duration or fulfillment time.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Check the actual license and enrollment terms.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A tester uses a non-Windows host and wants to run Commander. Which preparation is sound?

options.text: Install a native macOS Commander package.
Assume no Windows access can ever work.
Assume the desktop Commander needs only a browser.
Arrange a compatible supported Windows environment and verify the specific architecture and setup.

practiceQuiz.rationale: Supported Windows access is required; no particular hypervisor is automatically certified.

optionExplanations.A: No native macOS Commander package is established.
optionExplanations.B: This excludes possible supported Windows access without evidence.
optionExplanations.C: Desktop Commander is not simply a browser application.
optionExplanations.D: This checks compatibility instead of assuming a host workaround.

practiceQuiz.scenario: For online node-locked activation in Tosca 2023.2 or later, which path starts configuration?

options.text: Project → License → Setup → Activate licenses → Local Machine.
Double-click a license file and assume activation.
Wait for an unsolicited support email to activate the installation.
Copy any file into the installation directory.

practiceQuiz.hint: Use the documented path for this license model.
practiceQuiz.rationale: This version-specific path starts node-locked activation; other licensing models differ.

optionExplanations.A: This selects the documented activation flow.
optionExplanations.B: Automatic file activation is not this flow.
optionExplanations.D: Arbitrary file copying does not configure this model.

practiceQuiz.scenario: In a local Windows-guest Chrome scanning exercise, the extension exists only in a separate host browser. What preparation is missing?

options.text: Assume Chrome can never be scanned.
Install and enable the required extension in the guest browser being scanned.
Replace all licenses without inspecting them.
Delete the application under test.

practiceQuiz.rationale: An unrelated host-browser extension does not prepare this local guest browser.

optionExplanations.B: This addresses the stated environment mismatch.
optionExplanations.C: The scenario identifies no license fault.
optionExplanations.D: Deleting the application does not configure scanning.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Commander reports no usable license. What is an appropriate first investigation?

options.text: Reinstall immediately and assume corruption.
Assume every license activates after 24 hours.
Inspect the configured license source, availability, validity and connectivity.
Copy an arbitrary .lic file into the installation directory.

practiceQuiz.rationale: The symptom does not establish a single cause.

optionExplanations.A: Reinstallation assumes a cause without evidence.
optionExplanations.C: This gathers evidence for the assigned license model.
optionExplanations.D: This does not establish a valid entitlement.

practiceQuiz.scenario: For this independent local Chrome exercise against an authorized hosted sandbox, which THREE preparations matter?

options.text: A usable Commander installation and assigned license.
The required extension enabled in the target Chrome browser.
Access to the authorized sandbox and intended test data.
A mandatory localhost server regardless of the sandbox architecture.

practiceQuiz.rationale: A, B and C prepare this exercise; a local server is not inherently required.

optionExplanations.A: The tool and entitlement must be usable.
optionExplanations.B: The local XBrowser target needs its extension.
optionExplanations.C: Authorized access and suitable data are necessary for this scenario.
optionExplanations.D: A hosted sandbox does not inherently require a local server.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which is the safest application choice for an independent training exercise?

options.text: An arbitrary customer production database.
A production site with no authorization.
Any unrelated program, regardless of the exercise.
An authorized disposable sandbox with suitable test data.

practiceQuiz.rationale: Independent practice should use an appropriate authorized target rather than assume the original Academy SUT.

optionExplanations.A: Production data is inappropriate without scope and permission.
optionExplanations.C: An unrelated program does not meet the exercise needs.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Before connecting to an organizational cloud license server, what must you verify?

options.text: Your administrator added your account to that server.
Chrome Web Store issued a Tosca license.
A public website grants universal server access.
Every Tosca install includes every organizational license.

practiceQuiz.rationale: An account on the intended server is a prerequisite.

optionExplanations.A: This checks the documented access prerequisite.
optionExplanations.B: Browser extensions do not grant server entitlements.
optionExplanations.C: Public access does not grant organizational licensing.
optionExplanations.D: Installation does not imply every entitlement.

practiceQuiz.scenario: How should a learner schedule preparation around training-license access?

options.text: Assume licenses never expire.
Check actual eligibility, expiry and fulfillment terms before scheduling practice.
Request a new entitlement before every click.
Assume every license has the same duration.

practiceQuiz.rationale: Independent planning must follow real terms rather than a guessed duration or SLA.

optionExplanations.C: Per-click requests are not a justified licensing model.

quickRecap.value: Verify a compatible supported Windows environment.
Commander minimum RAM is 8 GB; consult the full release matrix.
Review prerequisites, components and completion logs.
Use the assigned model, not a universal .lic recipe.
Confirm your account is assigned to the intended server.
Prepare the actual local browser being scanned.
Use an authorized disposable application and suitable data.
Preparation does not prove application correctness.
Verify requirements in your own current Academy enrollment.
